finding.comment: 'retained forever and never deleted' is contradicted three lines later by the automatic 30-day purge; the two claims cannot both be true.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/retention.md
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+# Log retention
+
+Audit logs are retained forever and are never deleted.
+
+## Cost controls
+
+To bound storage spend, logs older than 30 days are purged
+automatically by the retention job.
